name: Impianti di risalita in Italia
description: Aerial lifts and surface lifts in Italy, extracted from OpenStreetMap and enriched with a resort slug. Derivative Database under ODbL 1.0.
attribution: Contains information from OpenStreetMap, which is made available under the Open Database License (ODbL).
method: Overpass API query for aerialway ways within Italy, then each lift matched to the nearest resort in our own resort list. Altitudes come from the Open-Meteo elevation model where OpenStreetMap has none.
